title: 修ScopedEpoch Proposal身份与退役ledger负控

run_accepted.basis: 12/12 cases; both mutants caught on their named assertions; frozen header sha unchanged

coverage.proposal_identity_gate: covered — generation, consumed, binding gates with named reasons
coverage.regulator_wiring_execution: not_covered — compile/run of the Regulator is out of scope for this offline step; the API it calls is unchanged

changed_files.reason: ProposalToken + ProbeResult + mint()/token_rejection()/commit(ScopedProposal&); consumption on success only; retired-ledger loop reports a distinct reason
original 6 cases kept verbatim (32 assertions) + 6 new identity/ledger cases
registration-first runner with named-assertion mutant verdicts

design_decisions.token_consumed_only_on_success: a guard-rejected commit (e.g. G5 job monotonicity) leaves the token usable, preserving the batch-103 EPV-E1 behaviour where the same proposal is retried with a valid job id
design_decisions.mint_after_propose: proposed_generation is recorded AFTER proposal, because try_open advances generation_ during a scoped open; recording it before stamped gen-1 tokens on a gen-2 proposal
design_decisions.distinct_ledger_reason: the retired-ledger guard now says scoped_open_binding_retired instead of sharing scoped_open_binding_not_new with the active-anchor check, so it is independently falsifiable
design_decisions.untokened_commit_kept: the plain commit(Proposal) overload remains for single-critical-section callers and the original 6 cases; crossing a lock boundary requires the tokened overload

real_defect_found_by_my_own_mutant: the first mutant attempt proved the ledger guard was unreachable-by-test, the same defect F124-05 reports; fixed by the distinct reason + dedicated case
remaining_obligations: the Regulator call site was NOT compiled (needs the ROS include set) and NOT run; the wrapper change is additive so the existing call still binds to commit(Proposal)
regulator wiring is not validated end to end offline
